svg.title: kevfang03's sky islands
svg.desc: A floating world that grows with kevfang03's GitHub activity, shown at dusk. Level 4 with 300 contributions; 6 repositories stand as buildings: ops-suite, desk-scene, portfolio, dotfiles, notes, hello-world. Now building ops-suite, 114 commits from its next tier. Your companion, Puff, waits on the HQ roof.

g.text: each repo is a building · commits upgrade it · contributions are XP
14-day streak · 6 repos · 240 this year · Philly 4:50 PM · Clear 48°F
